sample_data.title: SAMPLE Data
sample_data.description: Schema discovery + employee data for the Db2 for i SAMPLE library

list_sample_tables.description:
List all tables, views, and physical files in the SAMPLE library
with their text descriptions and object types. Use this first when
you need to know which objects are available in SAMPLE before
writing a query.

describe_sample_table.description:
Describe the columns of a table in the SAMPLE library: name, data
type, length, numeric scale, nullability, column text, and ordinal
position. Pass the unqualified table name (e.g., 'EMPLOYEE'). Use
this before writing any column-referencing SQL against a SAMPLE
table.

parameters.name: table_name
parameters.description: Unqualified table name in the SAMPLE library (e.g., 'EMPLOYEE')

list_sample_relationships.description:
List foreign-key relationships defined in the SAMPLE library:
constraint name, child table/column, referenced parent table/column,
and the delete/update rules. Use this to understand how SAMPLE
tables join before writing multi-table queries.

get_employee_details.description: Retrieve detailed information about an employee including department and manager

find_employees_by_department.description: List employees in a specific department

parameters.name: department_id
parameters.description: Department ID - Select from predefined departments

find_employees_by_job.description: Find employees with a specific job title

parameters.name: job_title
parameters.description: Job title - Select from common job titles

get_employee_projects.description: List projects an employee is working on

parameters.name: include_completed
parameters.description: Include completed projects (true) or only active projects (false)

get_department_salary_stats.description: Salary statistics by department with optional salary range filter

parameters.name: department_id
parameters.description: Department ID (e.g., 'A00') or '*ALL' for all departments

find_project_team_members.description: Find all employees working on specific projects. Accepts a JSON array of project IDs.

parameters.name: project_ids
parameters.description: Array of project IDs to search for. Must be a JSON array, not a string. Example: ["MA2100", "AD3100", "AD3110"]

calculate_employee_bonus.description: Calculate potential bonus for an employee based on performance rating and salary

search_employees.description: Search for employees by name with pagination
